articles.title_en: Housing in Medicaid: Should It Really Change?
articles.title_cn: 医疗补助中的住房：是否真的应该改变？
articles.abstract_en: Housing is mostly exempted from Medicaid and Supplemental Social Insurance means tests. Reforms of this special treatment have been debated, but little is known about its costs, benefits, and redistributive implications. I estimate a life cycle model of single retirees accounting for this exemption. It shows that the homestead exemption explains important patterns of Medicaid recipiency and that it is highly valued. It also shows that estate recovery could cover most of its costs with possibly limited negative welfare consequences. Finally, the model predicts that removing the homestead exemption or enforcing estate recovery programs would reduce redistribution toward lower-income retirees. (JEL D15, G51, H51, I13, I18, I38, J26)
articles.abstract_cn: 住房在医疗补助和补充社会保险的资产审查中大多被豁免。关于这种特殊待遇的改革一直存在争议，但对其成本、收益和再分配影响知之甚少。我估计了一个考虑这一豁免的单身退休人员生命周期模型。该模型表明，宅基地豁免解释了医疗补助领取的重要模式，并且其价值很高。它还表明，遗产追偿可以覆盖其大部分成本，且可能带来有限的负面福利后果。最后，模型预测，取消宅基地豁免或强制执行遗产追偿计划将减少对低收入退休人员的再分配。（JEL D15, G51, H51, I13, I18, I38, J26）

articles.title_en: The Effect of Early Childhood Education on Adult Criminality: Evidence from the 1960s through 1990s
articles.title_cn: 早期儿童教育对成人犯罪的影响：来自1960年至1990年的证据
articles.abstract_en: We compare the effects of early childhood education on adult criminal behavior across time periods, using administrative crime data that provide significant precision advantages over existing work. We find that improvements in early childhood education led to large (20 percent) reductions in later criminal behavior, reductions that far exceed those implied by estimates of test score gains in prior studies. While the benefits generated account for a large portion of the costs of the education provided, we find substantial relative gains from the targeting of funds to high-poverty areas and areas without existing access to subsidized care. (JEL H75, I21, I26, I28, I32, I38, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用行政犯罪数据比较了不同时期早期儿童教育对成人犯罪行为的影响，这些数据相比现有研究具有显著的精度优势。我们发现，早期儿童教育的改善导致了后来犯罪行为的大幅减少（20%），这一减少幅度远超先前研究中基于考试成绩提升的估计所暗示的幅度。虽然所产生的收益占教育提供成本的很大一部分，但我们发现，将资金定向投入到高贫困地区以及没有现有补贴护理获取途径的地区，会带来可观的相对收益。（JEL H75, I21, I26, I28, I32, I38, K42）

articles.abstract_en: Residual profit allocation (RPA) schemes have come to prominence in discussions of international tax reform but with almost nothing known about their economic impact. These schemes tax multinationals by allocating their “routine” profits to source countries and sharing their remaining “residual” profit across countries on some formulaic basis. This paper explores the implications, conceptual and empirical, of moving to some form of RPA. Residual profits are estimated to be substantial and concentrated in relatively few multinational enterprises. The impact on tax revenue appears beneficial for developing countries. Aggregate production efficiency is unlikely to increase unless routine profits are lightly taxed. (JEL F23, H25, H87, L25)
articles.abstract_cn: 剩余利润分配（RPA）方案在国际税收改革讨论中日益突出，但对其经济影响几乎一无所知。这些方案通过对跨国公司的“常规”利润在来源国征税，并基于某种公式化基础在各国间分享其剩余的“剩余”利润来对其征税。本文探讨了转向某种形式的RPA在概念上和实证上的影响。估计剩余利润规模可观，且集中在相对较少的跨国企业中。对税收收入的影响似乎有利于发展中国家。除非常规利润被轻税，否则总体生产效率不太可能提高。（JEL F23, H25, H87, L25）

articles.title_en: Tax Audits as Scarecrows: Evidence from a Large-Scale Field Experiment
articles.title_cn: 税收审计作为稻草人：来自大规模实地实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: The canonical model of Allingham and Sandmo (1972) predicts that firms evade taxes by optimally trading off between the costs and benefits of evasion. However, there is no direct evidence that firms react to audits in this way. We conducted a large-scale field experiment in collaboration with a tax authority to address this question. We sent letters to 20,440 small- and medium-sized firms that collectively paid more than US$200 million in taxes per year. We find that providing information about audits significantly affected tax compliance but in a manner that was inconsistent with Allingham and Sandmo (1972). (JEL C93, D22, H25, H26, K34, L25, O14)
articles.abstract_cn: Allingham和Sandmo（1972）的经典模型预测，企业通过最优权衡逃税的成本与收益来逃税。然而，没有直接证据表明企业以这种方式对审计做出反应。我们与税务机关合作进行了一项大规模实地实验来解决这个问题。我们向20,440家中小企业发送了信件，这些企业每年共同缴纳超过200万美元的税款。我们发现，提供审计信息显著影响了税收合规，但其方式与Allingham和Sandmo（1972）不一致。（JEL C93, D22, H25, H26, K34, L25, O14）

articles.title_en: The Employment Effects of Countercyclical Public Investments
articles.title_cn: 逆周期公共投资的就业效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the causal impact of a sizable German public investment program on employment at the county level. The program focused on improving the energy efficiency of school buildings, making it possible to use the number of schools as an instrument for investments. It also enforced tight deadlines, reducing potential implementation lags. The program was cost-effective, creating, on average, one job for one year for an investment of €24,000. The employment gains are detectable after nine months and are accompanied by an unemployment reduction amounting to half of the job creation. Employment grew predominately in the directly affected industries. (JEL E24, E32, E62, H54, J23, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估计了一项规模可观的德国公共投资计划在县级层面对就业的因果影响。该计划侧重于提高学校建筑的能源效率，从而可以利用学校数量作为投资的工具变量。该计划还规定了严格的截止日期，减少了潜在的落实滞后。该计划具有成本效益，平均每投资24,000欧元即可创造一个持续一年的工作岗位。就业增长在九个月后即可检测到，并伴随着失业减少，其规模相当于新增就业的一半。就业增长主要发生在直接受影响的行业。（JEL E24, E32, E62, H54, J23, R23）

articles.title_en: SOEs and Soft Incentive Constraints in State Bank Lending
articles.title_cn: 国有企业与国有银行贷款中的软激励约束
articles.abstract_en: We study how Chinese state bank managers’ lending incentives impact lending to state-owned enterprises (SOEs). We show lending quantity increases and quality decreases at month’s end, indicating monthly lending targets that decrease lending standards. Increased quantity comes from both SOEs and private lending, whereas decreased quality is from only SOEs, which continue to receive loans even after prior defaults (particularly at month’s end). We suggest that SOE lending may thus be beneficial for state bank managers, who lend to delinquent state enterprises to meet targets, which in turn may exacerbate SOEs’ soft budget constraints. (JEL G21, G28, L32, O16, P34).
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究中国国有银行经理的贷款激励如何影响对国有企业的贷款。我们发现在月末，贷款数量增加而质量下降，这表明月度贷款目标降低了贷款标准。数量的增加来自国有企业和私人贷款，而质量的下降仅来自国有企业，这些企业在先前违约后仍继续获得贷款（尤其是在月末）。我们认为，国有企业贷款可能因此对国有银行经理有利，他们向违约的国有企业放贷以达到目标，这反过来可能加剧国有企业的软预算约束。（JEL G21, G28, L32, O16, P34）。

articles.title_en: Economic Effects of Environmental Crises: Evidence from Flint, Michigan
articles.title_cn: 环境危机的经济影响：来自密歇根州弗林特的证据
articles.abstract_en: In April 2014 Flint, Michigan switched its drinking water supply from the Detroit water system to the Flint River as a temporary means to save $5 million. Over 18 months it was revealed that the switch exposed residents to dangerous levels of lead, culminating in an emergency declaration in October 2015. This paper examines the impact of this crisis on the Flint housing market. The value of Flint’s housing stock has fallen by $520 million to $559 million despite over $400 million in remediation spending. Home prices remain depressed through August 2019, 16 months after the water was declared safe for consumption. (JEL H12, I12, Q25, Q51, Q53, R31)
articles.abstract_cn: 2014年四月，密歇根州弗林特市将其饮用水供应从底特律供水系统切换到弗林特河，作为节省5万美元的临时手段。18个月后，人们发现这一切换使居民暴露于危险水平的铅中，最终于2015年十月宣布进入紧急状态。本文考察了这一危机对弗林特住房市场的影响。尽管 remediation 支出超过520亿美元，弗林特住房存量的价值仍下降了559亿至400亿美元。在饮用水被宣布安全可饮用2019个月后，即截至16年八月，房价仍处于低迷状态。(JEL H12, I12, Q25, Q51, Q53, R31)

articles.title_en: The Extension of Credit with Nonexclusive Contracts and Sequential Banking Externalities
articles.title_cn: 非排他性合约与顺序银行外部性下的信贷扩展
articles.abstract_en: Nonexclusive sequential borrowing can increase default and impose externalities on prior lenders. We document that sequential banking is pervasive with substantial effects. Using credit card applications from a large bank and data on the applicants’ entire loan portfolios, we find that an additional credit line causes a 5.9 percentage point decline in default for high-score borrowers on previous loans. However, for low-score borrowers, it causes a 19 percentage point increase. The former use the new credit to smooth payments on preexisting loans, while the latter increase their total debt. These results have implications for “ no-universal-default” regulation and financial inclusion. (JEL D62, D82, G21, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 非排他性的顺序借款可能增加违约并对先前的贷款人施加外部性。我们记录了顺序银行普遍存在且具有实质性影响。利用一家大型银行的信用卡申请数据以及申请人全部贷款组合的数据，我们发现，对于高信用评分借款人，额外的一条信用额度导致先前贷款的违约率下降5.9个百分点。然而，对于低信用评分借款人，它导致违约率上升19个百分点。前者利用新信贷来平滑先前贷款的还款，而后者则增加了其总债务。这些结果对“非普遍违约”监管和金融包容性具有启示意义。(JEL D62, D82, G21, G51)

articles.title_en: Expanding Access to Clean Water for the Rural Poor: Experimental Evidence from Malawi
articles.title_cn: 扩大农村贫困人口获得清洁用水的途径：来自马拉维的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Data from an 18-month randomized trial show large and sustained impacts on water purification and child health of a program providing monthly coupons for free water treatment solution to households with young children. The program is more effective and much more cost effective than asking Community Health Workers (CHWs) to distribute free chlorine to households during routine monthly visits. This is because only 40 percent of households use free chlorine, targeting through CHWs is worse than self-targeting through coupon redemption, and water treatment promotion by CHWs does not increase chlorine use among beneficiaries of free chlorine. (JEL I12, I18, J13, O12, O13, Q53)
articles.abstract_cn: 一项为期18个月的随机试验数据显示，一项为有幼儿家庭提供免费水处理溶液月度优惠券的计划，对水净化和儿童健康产生了显著且持续的影响。该计划比要求社区卫生工作者（CHWs）在常规月度家访期间向家庭分发免费氯更有效，且成本效益更高。这是因为只有40%的家庭使用了免费氯，通过社区卫生工作者进行定向投放不如通过优惠券兑换实现自我定向，且社区卫生工作者进行的水处理推广并未提高免费氯受益者中氯的使用率。（JEL I12, I18, J13, O12, O13, Q53）

articles.title_en: Employed in a SNAP? The Impact of Work Requirements on Program Participation and Labor Supply
articles.title_cn: 在SNAP中就业？工作要求对项目参与和劳动力供给的影响
articles.abstract_en: Work requirements are common in US safety net programs. Evidence remains limited, however, on the extent to which work requirements increase economic self-sufficiency or screen out vulnerable individuals. Using linked administrative data on food stamps (SNAP) and earnings with a regression discontinuity design, we find robust evidence that work requirements increase program exits by 23 percentage points (64 percent) among incumbent participants. Overall program participation among adults who are subject to work requirements is reduced by 53 percent. Homeless adults are disproportionately screened out. We find no effects on employment and suggestive evidence of increased earnings in some specifications. (JEL H75, I18, I32, I38, J22, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 工作要求在美国安全网项目中很常见。然而，关于工作要求在多大程度上提高经济自给自足或筛选出弱势个体的证据仍然有限。利用食品券（SNAP）和收入的关联行政数据以及断点回归设计，我们发现强有力的证据表明，工作要求使现有参与者的项目退出率增加了23个百分点（64%）。在受工作要求约束的成年人中，总体项目参与率降低了53%。无家可归的成年人被不成比例地筛选出去。我们发现对就业没有影响，并且在某些规格中暗示收入增加的证据。（JEL H75, I18, I32, I38, J22, J31）

articles.title_en: Implications of Tax Loss Asymmetry for Owners of S Corporations
articles.title_cn: 税收损失不对称对S公司所有者的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study tax loss asymmetry for S corporate owners. These owners use most losses contemporaneously, reducing the tax asymmetry compared to C corporations. However, these owners face distortions due to the progressive individual tax schedule. The value of this asymmetry is approximately $3.5 billion per year. We find that this asymmetry creates disincentives for risky investment and causes allocative inefficiencies among loss and gains owners. Finally, we simulate the effects of certain provisions of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act; we estimate that these provisions—especially section 199A—reduce the behavioral distortions of the asymmetry for S corporate owners. (JEL D22, G32, H25, H32, K34)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了S公司所有者的税收损失不对称性。这些所有者当期使用大部分损失，与C公司相比减少了税收不对称性。然而，这些所有者面临累进个人税表造成的扭曲。这种不对称的价值约为每年3.5亿美元。我们发现，这种不对称对风险投资产生了抑制作用，并导致损失和收益所有者之间的配置无效率。最后，我们模拟了《减税与就业法案》某些条款的影响；我们估计这些条款——尤其是第199A条——减少了S公司所有者不对称性的行为扭曲。(JEL D22, G32, H25, H32, K34)

articles.title_en: Health Effects of Increasing Income for the Elderly: Evidence from a Chilean Pension Program
articles.title_cn: 增加老年人收入对健康的影响：来自智利养老金计划的证据
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the effect of a permanent income increase on the health outcomes of the elderly poor. Our regression discontinuity design exploits an eligibility cutoff in a Chilean basic pension program that grants monthly payments to retirees without a contributory pension. Using administrative data, we find that four years after applying, basic pension recipients are 2.7 percentage points less likely to have died. Survey evidence suggests an increase in food consumption and visits to health centers as relevant drivers of the mortality reduction. (JEL D63, G51, I12, I14, I38, J14, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了永久性收入增加对贫困老年人健康结果的影响。我们的断点回归设计利用了智利基本养老金计划中的资格截止点，该计划向没有缴费型养老金的退休人员提供每月支付。使用行政数据，我们发现申请四年后，基本养老金领取者的死亡可能性降低了2.7个百分点。调查证据表明，食品消费和健康中心就诊的增加是死亡率降低的相关驱动因素。（JEL D63, G51, I12, I14, I38, J14, O15）

articles.title_en: The Economic Consequences of Being Denied an Abortion
articles.title_cn: 被拒绝堕胎的经济后果
articles.abstract_en: This paper evaluates the financial and economic consequences of being denied an abortion. We link credit report data to the Turnaway Study, which collected high-quality, longitudinal data on women receiving or being denied a wanted abortion in the United States. We compare financial outcomes over a ten-year period for women who had pregnancies just above and below a gestational age limit allowing for a wanted abortion. Outcomes evolved similarly for the two groups prior to the abortion encounter. Following the encounter, women who were denied an abortion experience a large increase in financial distress that remains for several years. (JEL G51, I18, J13, J16)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了被拒绝堕胎的财务和经济后果。我们将信用报告数据与Turnaway研究相关联，该研究收集了美国接受或拒绝想要堕胎的女性的高质量纵向数据。我们比较了妊娠年龄限制略高于和略低于允许想要堕胎的女性在十年期间的财务结果。在堕胎遭遇之前，两组的结果演变相似。在遭遇之后，被拒绝堕胎的女性经历了财务困境的大幅增加，这种困境持续了数年。（JEL G51, I18, J13, J16）

articles.title_en: School Boards and Education Production: Evidence from Randomized Ballot Order
articles.title_cn: 学校董事会与教育生产：来自随机选票顺序的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine the causal influence of educators elected to the school board on local education production. The key empirical challenge is that school board composition is endogenously determined through the electoral process. To overcome this, we develop a novel research design that leverages California’s randomized assignment of the order that candidate names appear on election ballots. We find that an additional educator elected to the school board reduces charter schooling and increases teacher salaries in the school district relative to other board members. We interpret these findings as consistent with educator board members shifting bargaining in favor of teachers’ unions. (JEL D72, H75, I21, J31, J45, J51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了当选为学校董事会的教育工作者对当地教育生产的因果影响。关键的经验挑战在于，学校董事会的构成是通过选举过程内生决定的。为了克服这一点，我们开发了一种新颖的研究设计，利用加利福尼亚州对候选人姓名在选举选票上出现顺序的随机分配。我们发现，相对于其他董事会成员，每多一位教育工作者当选为学校董事会成员，会减少特许学校教育并增加学区的教师工资。我们将这些发现解释为与教育工作者董事会成员将谈判转向有利于教师工会的方向一致。(JEL D72, H75, I21, J31, J45, J51)

articles.title_en: What Does a Provider Network Do? Evidence from Random Assignment in Medicaid Managed Care
articles.title_cn: 提供者网络的作用是什么？来自医疗补助管理护理随机分配的证据
articles.abstract_en: Leveraging the random assignment of over 50,000 Medicaid enrollees in New York, I present causal evidence that narrower networks are a blunt instrument for reducing health care spending. While narrower networks constrain spending, they do so by generating hassle costs that reduce quantity, with modest effects on prices paid to providers. Enrollees assigned to narrower networks use fewer of both needed and unneeded services and are less satisfied with their plans. Using my causal estimates to construct counterfactuals, I identify an alternative assignment policy that reduces spending without harming satisfaction by matching consumers with narrower networks that include their providers. (JEL H51, H75, I13, I18, I38)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用纽约超过50,000名医疗补助参保者的随机分配，我提供了因果证据表明，较窄的网络是减少医疗保健支出的一个粗略工具。虽然较窄的网络限制了支出，但这是通过产生麻烦成本来减少数量，而对支付给提供者的价格影响不大。被分配到较窄网络的参保者使用的必要和非必要服务都较少，并且对计划的满意度较低。利用我的因果估计构建反事实，我确定了一种替代分配政策，该政策通过将消费者与包含其提供者的较窄网络匹配，在不损害满意度的情况下减少支出。(JEL H51, H75, I13, I18, I38)

articles.title_en: Student Performance, Peer Effects, and Friend Networks: Evidence from a Randomized Peer Intervention
articles.title_cn: 学生表现、同伴效应与朋友网络：来自随机同伴干预的证据
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the effects of an educational peer intervention in which previously high- and low-achieving students are randomly paired as deskmates in elementary schools in China. Our treatment boosts the mathematics scores of the low-achieving students. Moreover, the treatment enhances the extraversion and agreeableness of high- and low-achieving students, thereby providing evidence that peers can influence personality traits. The positive treatment effects can be attributed to the deskmate-level peer effects. We document friend network structure changes and present additional evidence on how friendship ties help us better understand the mechanisms behind peer effects. (JEL I21, I26, J24, O15, P36, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了一项教育同伴干预的效果，在该干预中，中国小学中先前成绩高和成绩低的学生被随机配对为同桌。我们的处理提高了低成就学生的数学成绩。此外，该处理增强了高成就和低成就学生的外向性和宜人性，从而提供了同伴可以影响人格特质的证据。积极处理效应可归因于同桌层面的同伴效应。我们记录了朋友网络结构的变化，并提供了关于友谊联系如何帮助我们更好地理解同伴效应背后机制的额外证据。(JEL I21, I26, J24, O15, P36, Z13)
